name: responses.stream.m7-function-call-output-loss
description: A streamed function_call_output item with response.output_item.added followed directly by response.output_item.done and a terminal completed response is an unsupported M7 semantic: exactly one unsupported-semantic loss at the item, item completion is absorbed, and no IR content block is emitted (N-S-10). This vector validates item-completion absorption only; the current typed StreamEvent codec exposes no legal function_call_output descendant event.

expected_losses.detail: N-S-10: Responses function_call_output has no supported IR block mapping; response.output_item.done completes and is absorbed for this item-only lifecycle vector
